# Brand survey with explicit mean-structure lines: a free latent mean
# identified by a zero marker intercept, two intercepts held equal by a
# shared label, and an observed exogenous covariate (fixed.x).
quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3
value =~ v1 + v2 + v3
service =~ s1 + s2 + s3
recommend ~ quality + value + service + wave
quality ~ 1
q1 ~ 0*1
v2 ~ i*1
v3 ~ i*1
